original_text: Budh, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will consider money, as most important, be beautiful, attached to women, friendly and very valorous.

effects.description: Will consider money as most important

original_text: Budh, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be subjected to phlegmatic diseases, fond of meat etc., will have hard teeth and coarse hair, be hard-hearted and will create terror among the people.

effects.description: Will be subjected to phlegmatic diseases
Will have hard teeth and coarse hair
Will create terror among the people

original_text: Budh, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have swarthy body, be windy in temperament, be libidinous, torturous and very argumentative.

Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will stick to religious observations, with delight in the contemplation of Supreme Spirit, will advocate final Emancipation effectively and be devoid of fear of tens of millions in kind.

effects.description: With delight in the contemplation of Supreme Spirit
Be devoid of fear of tens of millions in kind

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Budh in the 1 st Bhava: will be very sickly, will not be good-natured, will be interested in sinful acts, be ungrateful and will suffer from physical ailments.

effects.description: Will be interested in sinful acts

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Guru in the 1st Bhava: will be interested in bad acts, sick, sinful thankless, devoid of learning, ugly and fearful.

effects.description: Will be interested in bad acts

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will wander purposelessly, will cheat others, be interested in blaming and be timid.
Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will be interested in being just and be virtuous, will be ugly, forsaken by servants and will cheat others.

effects.description: Will be interested in being just

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Budh, Guru in the 1st Bhava: will be very timid, be a cheat, be attached to relatives and hardhearted.
Sürya, Candr, Budh, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will like bad odour, be indigent, foolish, will not have friends and will be defeated by enemies.
Sürya, Candr, Budh, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be foolish, nightblind, will be interested in residing in bad places and be very poor.

effects.description: Will be interested in residing in bad places

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will be untruthful, will have few sons, will speak harshly, will be won over by enemies and will be subjected to grief.

effects.description: Will be won over by enemies

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Guru, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will be dull-witted, have control over his senses, be skilful in taking things from others and be honoured for his deeds.

effects.description: Be skilful in taking things from others

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be auspicious, be dejected with people, will be very fair in complexion, will not have much money, will be hard in disposition.

effects.description: Will be very fair in complexion

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Budh, Guru in the 1 st Bhava: will be very valorous, will have voice, resembling that of a crow, be unkind, will have less money and will have physical deficiencies out of sickness etc.

effects.description: Will have voice resembling that of a crow
Will have physical deficiencies out of sickness etc.

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Budh, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have interest in sexual affairs, be expert in gambling, be unkind, more phlegmatic in temperament and be not bright in appearance.

effects.description: Will have interest in sexual affairs

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will be troubled by sickness, will have vices, be very miserable and unkind.
Sürya, Maìgal, Guru, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will have fearful eyes, will spend in bad ways, will wear rags and will be dejected with his wife, but attached to his son.

effects.description: Will be dejected with his wife

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will not be efficacious, be always insulted and be fickle-minded.
Sürya, Budh, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will have ugly eyes, be unkind and disturbed.
Sürya, Budh, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will do irreligious things in times of danger, will serve mean people, be ill-natured, shameless and will face troubles from the king.

effects.description: Will do irreligious things in times of danger
Will face troubles from the king

original_text: Sürya, Budh, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be given to anger, will have wicked wife, will always be a servant and be forsaken by his relatives. He will be inimical to all.
Sürya, Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will promote quarrels, be wicked, be immodest and will always move with sinful persons.

effects.description: Will always move with sinful persons

original_text: Candr, Mangal, Budh, Guru in the 1st Bhava: will possess a very dark and long body, will be interested in fighting, will suffer from bloody disorders and will poorly dress himself.

effects.description: Will possess a very dark and long body

original_text: Candr, Maìgal, Budh, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will not have sons and wealth, will have ugly ears, teeth and eyes, be a voracious eater, be ascetic and wicked.

effects.description: Will have ugly ears, teeth and eyes

original_text: Candr, Mangal, Budh, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will have uneven legs, ugly hair and ugly teeth.
Candr, Maìgal, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will have un ugly physique, ugly nails and ugly sides, will indulge in acceptable deeds and will be a tale-bearer.
Candr, Maìgal, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be very famous, be helpful to others, be free from enemies, be attached to his sons and affectionate to his preceptors.
Maìgal, Budh, Guru, Çukr in the 1 st Bhava: will be endowed with sons and a fleet of horse, be interested in Çästras, will destroy sinners, be quite famous and be pure-hearted.

effects.description: Endowed with a fleet of horse

original_text: Mangal, Budh, Guru, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will be foolish, be phlegmatic and windy, dear to preceptors and be not proud.
Mangal, Budh, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have horrible notions, be long-bodied, will wear twisted hair, as an ascetic, be not virtuous, subject to skin afflictions and will suffer from itches.

effects.description: Will wear twisted hair, as an ascetic

original_text: Maìgal, Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be a bald-headed, fearless, learned, black in complexion and be in auspicious.
Budh, Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be very efficacious, will have good (i.e. beautiful, or strong) nails, be tall, patient, will have beautiful hands and be fair complexioned.

effects.description: Will have good (beautiful or strong) nails

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Budh, Guru in the 1st Bhava: will be very wealthy, be interested in Çästras, be dear to elders and be attached to his sons.
Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Budh, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will be important by virtue of his good qualities, be good looking, be devoted to help the public and liberal in giving donations.

effects.description: Will be important by virtue of his good qualities
Be devoted to help the public

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Budh, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will beat (or kill) firmly, be unkind, will be strong bodied and be bereft of wisdom.
Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Guru, Çukr in the 1 st Bhava: will be firm in disposition, very efficacious, cruel, be a poet, be famous and dejected.
Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have wounded body, will eat voraciously, be unjustly disposed, be very splendourous and be highly given to sexual feelings.

effects.description: Be highly given to sexual feelings

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Maìgal, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have interest in others wealth, will have long penis, will be full of veins, will have foul smell in the body and be cruel.

effects.description: Will have interest in others' wealth
Will have foul smell in the body

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Budh, Guru, Çukr in the 1st Bhava: will be endowed with sons, learning, wealth and relatives and will have attractive eyes, ears, teeth and nose.

effects.description: Will have attractive eyes, ears, teeth and nose

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Budh, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have sickly body, will be bilious and phlegmatic in temperament and will always move in forests.

effects.description: Will be bilious and phlegmatic in temperament

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Budh, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will have own business, will have income through arts, be liberal in giving away gifts and will be endowed with all pleasures.

effects.description: Be liberal in giving away gifts
Will be endowed with all pleasures

original_text: Sürya, Candr, Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1 st Bhava: will be free form grief and fear, be inactive, or foolish due to some sin, or blemish and will be highly pious.

effects.description: Will be free from grief and fear
Be inactive, or foolish due to some sin, or blemish

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Budh, Guru, Çukr in the 1 st Bhava: will consider justice, as the most supreme aim, will have virtues, be truthful, be dear to the virtuous and will have pleasing looks.

effects.description: Will consider justice as the most supreme aim

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Budh, Guru, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be subjected, troubles by abundantly, labouring, will be extremely emaciated, skilful in spending, expert in guess, be devoid of wealth, be phlegmatic, expert in promoting quarrels and will cheat.

effects.description: Will be subjected to abundant troubles

original_text: Sürya, Maìgal, Guru, Çukr, Çani in the 1st Bhava: will be worshipped by Lord Indra (i.e. so superior a person), will eat and drink abundantly, will be interested in possessing conveyances, will possess attractive eyes and be unkind.

effects.description: Will be worshipped by Lord Indra (superior person)
